title: Bootstrapping Niche Multilingual Code Translation via Reinforcement Learning with Execution-Based Verifiable Supervision
abstract: arXiv:2608.13854v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Code translation must preserve executable behavior across many programming languages, yet neural code translation has largely focused on a few popular languages such as C++, Java, and Python. This leaves a niche, many-to-many setting where parallel supervision is sparse, producing plausible but non-executable translations. We address this setting with preference-based reinforcement learning driven by execution-based supervision. Our pipeline firstly expands verifiable seed Python programs into a multilingual pool of execution-validated codes. Using the pool, a base LLM generates translation candidates across language pairs, which we label by their execution outcomes. The resulting preferences are used to train a reward model that scores cross-language translation quality. Finally, we optimize our base LLMs with GRPO over 600 directed language pairs (25 x 24) using the reward model as a signal. To evaluate the niche translation capability

translated_title: 通过基于执行的验证监督强化学习引导小众多语言代码翻译
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.13854v1 公告类型：新 摘要：代码翻译必须在多种编程语言中保持可执行行为，然而神经代码翻译主要集中在少数流行语言，如C++、Java和Python。这留下了一个小众的、多对多场景，其中并行监督稀疏，产生看似合理但不可执行的翻译。我们通过基于执行的监督驱动的偏好强化学习来解决这一设置。我们的流程首先将可验证的种子Python程序扩展为经过执行验证的多语言代码池。利用该池，基础LLM生成跨语言对的翻译候选，我们根据其执行结果进行标记。由此产生的偏好用于训练一个奖励模型，该模型对跨语言翻译质量进行评分。最后，我们使用GRPO在600个定向语言对（25×24）上优化基础LLM，以奖励模型作为信号。为了评估小众翻译能力
tldr: 本文提出一种利用执行验证监督和偏好强化学习的方法，通过构建多语言代码池和奖励模型，在600个语言对上优化基础LLM，从而解决小众多语言代码翻译中并行监督稀疏导致的不可执行问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a method using execution-based verifiable supervision and preference reinforcement learning, building a multilingual code pool and reward model to optimize base LLMs across 600 language pairs, addressing the non-executable translation issue in niche multilingual code translation with sparse parallel supervision.
